entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 8237 of 2023
Petitioner :- Sukhvinder Singh And Others

Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Civil Secrt. Lko. And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Dharm Trivedi

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Neeraj Kumar Mishra,Trilok Kumar Trivedi
Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
1.

Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents and Shri
Neeraj Kumar Mishra, Advocate, who has filed caveat on behalf of the private respondent.

2.  This petition has been filed with the following main prayer:-
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction, in the nature of Certiorari quashing the impugned F.I.R. lodged by the opposite party No. 4 against the petitioners at Police Station- Mohammdi, District-Kheri on 18-09-2023, U/S 419,420,467,468,471,504,506 I.P.C vide Crime No. 0610/2023, contained as Annexure No. 1 to this writ petition.

Sukhvinder Singh And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Civil ... on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127654437/
1 (ii) Issue a writ, order or direction, in the nature of Mandamus commanding the opposite parties not to arrest and harass the petitioners on the basis of the impugned F.I.R."
3.

entities.text: Sukhvinder Singh And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Civil
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the allegations in the First Information Report relate to a fraudulent sale deed and said to have been executed by the father of the informant in favour of the petitioners in the year 2001, which was cancelled by the Civil Judge, Junior Division Mohammadi Kheri by his order dated 24.12.2004.
4.

entities.text: Civil Judge, Junior Division Mohammadi Kheri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It has been submitted that there was no reason for the petitioners to approach the informant and to threat him to take over the land which belongs to him after the sale deed was cancelled by the competent court in the year 2004.
5. This court has perused the First Information Report and also heard learned counsel for the informant.

It has been orally argued by the learned counsel for the informant that although the sale deed dated 29.3.2001 was cancelled by the competent court on 24.12.2004 they have taken loan on the property now illegally which belongs to the informant, from a bank by mortgaging the said property.
6. This court having gone through the First Information Report finds no good ground to show interference.
7. The writ petition is, accordingly, dismissed.
